delta.definition: Share(Candidate) - Share(Control), where Share is the mean over Cases of each Case's share of Repeats scored true; every Case has the same weight; positive means the Candidate is better (the Criterion is higher-is-better)
delta.unit: share of Repeats per Case, every Case weighted equally

limitations: The Repeats of a Case are not independent samples: the Comparison carries no binomial interval over Episodes, no confidence interval and no significance claim; every Case weighs the same.
Latency and the numbers of model and tool calls are descriptive only, and no Criterion rests on them; tokens and cost are null where they are not observable, never 0, and no cost is compared.
The shares describe the Cases of this Workload, not agents in general.
The two Attempts record the same code environment; this does not establish that the two executions were identical.
